function.name: StdMarshalCF_QueryInterface
function.description: This function checks if the provided interface ID matches either IID_IUnknown or IID_IClassFactory. If it does, it sets the value of the third parameter to the interface and returns S_OK. If it doesn't, it returns E_NOINTERFACE.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the interface that is being queried

parameters.name: riid
parameters.description: Reference to the interface identifier that is being requested

parameters.name: ppv
parameters.description: Pointer to a pointer that, on successful return, points to the requested interface

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. S_OK if the interface is supported, E_NOINTERFACE otherwise

function.name: StdMarshalCF_AddRef
function.description: This function returns a static value of 2, indicating a non-heap based object.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This parameter is not used in the function.

function.return_type: ULONG, represents a non-heap based object.

function.name: StdMarshalCF_Release
function.description: This function returns a static value 1, indicating a non-heap based object.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This parameter is an interface pointer of type LPCLASSFACTORY.

function.return_type: ULONG, representing a non-heap based object.

function.name: StdMarshalCF_CreateInstance
function.description: This function checks if the provided interface identifier (riid) is equal to IID_IUnknown or IID_IMarshal. If it is, it calls the InternalCoStdMarshalObject function. If it's not, it returns an error message indicating that the interface is not supported.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the class factory interface

parameters.name: ppv
parameters.description: Pointer to the void pointer where the result or the created instance is stored

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the function call. Returns a success code if the interface is supported, otherwise returns E_NOINTERFACE

function.name: StdMarshalCF_LockServer
function.description: This function is a stub and currently only logs the fLock parameter value and returns S_OK.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This parameter is not used in the current implementation of the function.

parameters.name: fLock
parameters.description: This parameter is logged but not otherwise used in the current implementation of the function.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation, in this case always returns S_OK indicating a successful operation.

function.name: MARSHAL_GetStandardMarshalCF
function.description: This function assigns the address of StdMarshalCF to the pointer *ppv and returns S_OK.

parameters.name: ppv
parameters.description: A pointer to a pointer to a void. It is used to store the address of StdMarshalCF.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. In this case, it always returns S_OK indicating a successful operation.
